overview: The committee reviewed a proposed public tree ordinance, focusing on the calculation of fines for unauthorized removals and the management of a dedicated municipal tree fund.

items.title: Public Tree Ordinance Penalties
items.summary: The committee discussed enforcement and the methodology for calculating fines when public trees are removed from sidewalks or parks.

items.title: Tree Fund Oversight
items.summary: Councilors clarified that the Department of Public Works and the Tree Warden would oversee the special revenue account intended for tree maintenance and replanting.

items.title: Penalty Calculation Language
items.summary: Councilor Tseng introduced language revisions to clarify how fines relate to canopy coverage measurements versus the actual number of trees replanted on a site.
